Aggregated open positions. Without asOf, or with an asOf in the current fiscal quarter or later: the current lots, from the latest accounting run. With an earlier asOf: the snapshot at the last quarter or year end before it (`boundaryTs` says which). Cost basis only; the per-fiscal-year SOY/EOY endpoint is a specialization of this.
